name: Lake Nasser

method.comparison_domain: Common-valid pixels inside the buffered water outline

sources.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A / Element 84 Earth Search

limitations: Optical Sentinel-2 analysis, not NISAR radar analysis or field validation.
Water classification uses NDWI > 0 with cloud, shadow and snow masking; dark terrain and mixed shoreline pixels can affect the result.
Areas are measured only where both observation windows have usable data, inside the OSM water outline plus a 750 m buffer.
Each observation can mosaic several scenes within a seven-day window; inspect individual acquisition dates in the sources.
Analysis grid: 140 m. Boundary uncertainty is approximately one to two pixels; sub-pixel shoreline detail is not resolved.
Two observation windows show a surface-area difference, not water volume, a long-term trend, a forecast or a confirmed cause.
Gauge measurements and dam-release records have not been supplied. No causal explanation or model-performance score is inferred.
